sourceConvention.experimentalReference: Belle and Belle II Collaborations, arXiv:2507.01249
sourceConvention.equation: Delta k_D contains K_W c_WW V_ti^* V_tj with K_W=[y_t^2/(16 pi^2)][-3 alpha F(x_t)/(2 pi s_w^2)]

nuisanceFirewall.publishedLimitScope: The Belle B->K(*)a(a->gamma gamma) result reports a one-coupling g_aW interpretation. It is evidence that the detector record exists, not a ready-made two-coordinate likelihood.
nuisanceFirewall.admissionRule: Do not promote the isolated term to an observable row. First assemble the source-complete coefficient; only then test whether its nuisance-profiled Fisher/Jacobian retains rank two with the full experimental covariance.

boundary.closed: When isolated from the rest of Eq. (60), the explicit finite c_WW matching term supplies a mathematically independent formal row. This is a term-level certificate only.
boundary.notClosed: The source-complete MFV forward expression in Eq. (74) recombines this term with the other contributions into ctilde_WW, restoring a row parallel to (-1/2,1). AZ-081 therefore supersedes any detector-level rank inference from this isolated-term gate.
boundary.implication: The isolated term nominates source completeness as the decisive audit. A different process name is insufficient unless the complete measurable amplitude retains a non-collinear response.
boundary.nextCalculation: Use AZ-081 as the controlling boundary. Construct a gauge-complete differential W-associated amplitude, check Ward identities, then test its detector-folded shape derivatives for a non-collinear (A_2,c_WW) direction; retain B and K decays as held-out validation.
